Based on my analysis of the codebase, here are the three answers:

**1. Where is it guaranteed that no two articles share the same slug?**
`prisma/schema.prisma :: Article.slug` — Database unique constraint on slug field

**2. Where is it computed whether the requesting (current) user follows an article's author?**
`src/routes/articles.ts :: buildArticleResponse` — Queries Follow table (lines 60-71)

**3. Where is the authentication token verified on incoming requests?**
`src/middleware/auth.ts :: verifyToken` — Called in authenticate middleware (line 19)
